title: Prophecy Fragment
next_chapter_hook: At the moment Chen Xuan's figure vanished, an ancient yet familiar voice pierced through time and space, directly entering Chen Ji's Mental Sea—it was Ling Yuan's laughter, carrying hundreds of years of suppressed grudge and madness: Chen Xuan, in the end, you still lost!

text.content: Thousands of miles away, deep within the Tianqing Sect Forbidden Grounds. The stone platform where Ling Yuan sat withered suddenly cracked with a web-like pattern, and those murky old eyes snapped open, a look of incredulous astonishment flickering across his pupils. "This aura... the third page of the Tianji Record, actually awakening at this moment?" His voice was hoarse like dry leaves rubbing together, yet couldn't hide the chilling killing intent beneath. His palm pressed against the stone platform, the Forbidden Grounds formation rumbled to life, countless runes slithered out like serpents, gathering into a transmission spiritual light that rushed directly toward the Tianqing Sect Council Hall.

At the same time, in the core area of the ruins. Chen Ji's seated body trembled slightly, and the crack that had previously appeared at his Brow Center was spreading and expanding at a visible speed. Golden light burst from the crack,勾勒ing out a broken bamboo slip outline in the void—the third page of the Tianji Record, after thousands of years of silence, finally awakening completely at this moment. Mo Xiansheng's ethereal figure slowly emerged from the first page, and for the first time, a solemn expression appeared on his aged face: "The third page... Karmic Trace. Are you certain you wish to inherit it? The price... is far heavier than you can imagine."

Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, a faint smile curling at the corner of his mouth, containing both a thirst for unknown power and a clear understanding of the price. He didn't immediately respond to Mo Xiansheng's warning, but instead reached toward that golden outline. The moment his fingertip touched the bamboo slip, a torrential stream of information flooded into his Mental Sea like a breached flood—Karmic Trace could trace the root cause of any event and deduce its inevitable consequence, but each activation consumed fifty Heavenly Fate points and required one's own luck as an offering. Fifty points... He clicked his tongue internally. This was the equivalent of ten uses of foresight.

"The price is ruthless enough." Chen Ji chuckled low, yet there was not a trace of retreat in his brow. "But if I can't use it, then why bother awakening?" As his voice fell, he took a deep breath, and that newly acquired golden bamboo slip in his Mental Sea suddenly burst forth with dazzling radiance. In an instant, the world spun, and the surrounding scenery shattered like flowers in a mirror, replaced by a chaotic and vast void—here there was no time, no space, only countless karmic threads interwoven into a net, each one connecting a past that had passed or a future yet to unfold. He knew he had stepped into the River of Karma.

The karmic threads numbered in the millions; without guidance, it would be like finding a needle in a haystack. Chen Ji's mind stirred, and the foresight ability of the Tianji Record's first page and the deduction ability of the second page activated simultaneously. Where the three converged, a karmic main line emanating a faint blue glow suddenly appeared. Tracing back along this main line, countless fragmented scenes flashed by—a great cultivator's blood splattering across the long sky at the moment of death, an ancient sect's wails echoing everywhere during its destruction, a heaven and earth phenomenon when a divine artifact was born... until, a scene that made him stop breathing abruptly entered his sight.

dialogue.content: "That's... Senior Chen Xuan?" Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly, his pupils reflecting a breathtaking scene: sword lights like a rainstorm pouring down, a white-clad figure standing alone atop a mountain of blood and corpses, surrounded by dozens of pitch-black chains, each chain inscribed with eerie runes, frantically drawing his vitality. The other ends of those dozens of chains connected to dozens of faceless black-robed figures—their auras were赫然 all at the level of tribulation transcendence or above, truly extraordinary experts!

text.content: Chen Xuan—or rather, the young Chen Xuan, whose face bore a seventy percent resemblance to Chen Ji, only with a more carefree and unrestrained elegance between his brows. Blood dripped from the corner of his mouth, yet he laughed wildly and boldly: "Relying on you dogs of the Heavenly Dao, do you think you deserve to take my life?" Before his words even finished, he abruptly bit through his tongue, spraying a mouthful of refined blood onto a golden bamboo slip materializing in his palm. That bamboo slip was precisely the complete Tianji Record! The moment the refined blood touched the bamboo slip, the heavens and earth changed color, an oppressive might足以 tearing apart the azure sky burst forth from that bamboo slip, blasting the dozens of black shadows around him back a thousand miles.

"The price..." Chen Xuan's voice suddenly dropped, his smile fading, replaced by a complex expression interweaving resolve and compassion. He lowered his head to look at the bamboo slip in his hand, which was disintegrating and shattering at a visible speed, golden light turning into dotted stardust that merged into his body—"The Tianji Record shatters, heavenly fate counterattacks... My life will not last long. But remember, though I die, the inheritance of the Tianji Record will never be severed!" He abruptly raised his head, his gaze seemingly piercing through endless time and space, directly colliding with Chen Ji's line of sight, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his mouth: "Descendant... I await you in the future."

That one smile, crossing thousands of years of time, collided into Chen Ji's Mental Sea, striking him so hard that his entire body convulsed. All three pages of the Tianji Record simultaneously burst forth with dazzling radiance, forcibly extracting him from the River of Karma. The moment he returned to reality, he found himself drenched in sweat, his clothes completely soaked. "Cough..." A soft cough, and bright red blood spurted from the corner of his mouth. The agony of Heavenly Fate consumption far exceeded that of foresight, as if thousands of needles were simultaneously piercing his Mental Sea, or as if some invisible shackle was tightening inch by inch. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, carrying a hint of complexity: "Karmic Trace... You've only just glimpsed the threshold, yet you've already lost twenty Heavenly Fate points."

"Twenty points..." Chen Ji wiped away the blood at the corner of his mouth, yet his eyes blazed with intense light. "Worth it." He slowly rose, his gaze falling on the third page's illusion manifesting in his palm. At this moment, that golden bamboo slip had completely merged into his Mental Sea, standing side by side with the first two pages, emanating a distinctly different aura—the first page was foresight, the second page was deduction, and the third page was tracing. "With it, I can trace back to the source, find the true culprits who surrounded and killed Senior Chen Xuan... even find clues about my sister Chen Nian." He murmured softly, his eyes flashing a sharp light.

But Mo Xiansheng's words were like cold water pouring down: "Don't celebrate too early. Though Karmic Trace is powerful, it has a fatal flaw—you can only see the 'key nodes' on the karmic line, not the entire process. In other words, what you see is only what the other party wants you to see." Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, contemplating the meaning of these words. The scene of Chen Xuan's fall still echoed in his Mental Sea, especially that final smile and that gaze, as if hiding countless unspoken words. He vaguely sensed that this never-met ancestor had deliberately left behind a riddle before his death.

choice.prompt: Using Karmic Trace for the first time already consumed twenty Heavenly Fate points—a price no small matter. Next, Chen Ji faced a choice—

choices.description: First stabilize the foundation, wait for Heavenly Fate to recover before attempting to trace deeper karma. Seeking quick success often achieves the opposite effect.
choices.visible_reward: Stabilize the new ability, avoid depleting it
choices.risk_hint: Enemies may take advantage of the vulnerability

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcefully suppressing the restlessness in his heart. He was very clear that though the ability was already in hand, if he recklessly delved deeper without a stable foundation, it would be no different from digging his own grave. "Master Mo, is there a method to stabilize this third page...?" He asked, his voice having recovered its usual composure. Mo Xiansheng nodded: "A wise choice. First nourish it with spiritual energy for three days. After your Mental Sea adapts to the new ability, then we shall plan accordingly."

Right at this moment, hurried footsteps came from the ruins entrance. Su Qingyao's figure appeared at the end of the passage, her face pale, clearly having sensed the extraordinary disturbance just now: "Chen Ji, are you alright? That aura just now..." Before she finished speaking, her gaze fell on the un-dried blood at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth, her pupils contracting sharply: "You're injured?!"

choices.description: Strike while the iron is hot, immediately use Karmic Trace to investigate the complete truth of Chen Xuan's fall and the identities of those dozens of black shadows.
choices.visible_reward: Uncover historical truth, obtain key intelligence

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head, a flash of determination in his eyes: "Time waits for no one." He sat cross-legged again, and within his Mental Sea, the third page of the golden bamboo slip burst open. In an instant, a violent vertigo struck, ten times more intense than the first—the River of Causality surged like an angry dragon, countless scenes flickering past like a carousel, finally freezing on a scene that chilled him to the bone: those dozens of black shadows that shattered the Tianji Record, each bearing a symbol of a closed eye on their bodies! That was... the mark of the Heavenly Eye!

choices.description: Leave the ruins immediately and seek a safe location before making further plans. Since Ling Yuan has already detected the unusual activity, this place is no longer safe to linger.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity for deeper exploration

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly lifted his head, a sharp gleam flashing in his eyes. Ling Yuan's abnormal movements served as a reminder—this place had already been discovered, and if they didn't depart quickly, they might not be able to leave at all. "Senior Sister Su, come with me!" He grabbed Su Qingyao's wrist and vanished like a shadow, dashing toward the ruins' exit. Behind them, rumbling erupted suddenly as the forbidden formation was fully activated, and countless lethal arrays emerged like bamboo shoots after rain. He didn't look back, but internally calculated: Ling Yuan... since you're eager to reveal yourself, don't blame me for using you as a chess piece.

Whatever choice he made, the gears of fate had already begun to turn. Chen Ji lowered his gaze to his palm, where a brand-new golden pattern emerged—the mark left by the causal trace, and also the proof of his formal entry onto this reverse-heaven path. "Senior Chen Xuan..." he whispered, a hint of resolve flickering in his eyes, "You mentioned leaving a backup plan within the Tianji Record for me—what exactly is it?" Within his Mental Sea, the golden bamboo slip trembled gently, as if responding to his call. Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment before finally speaking: "He left not just a backup plan, but also a phrase—'At the end of heavenly secrets, one sees the true heart.'"

"At the end of heavenly secrets, one sees the true heart..." Chen Ji repeated, his brow furrowing deeper with confusion. At that moment, a sudden metamorphosis occurred! The newly-formed third page within his Mental Sea violently trembled, and from within the golden light seeped a wisp of ink-black mist. That mist twisted and squirmed, vaguely outlining the silhouette of a closed eye—identical to the symbol carried by those black shadows glimpsed in the River of Causality just moments before! "This..." Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply, an icy chill shooting from his tailbone to the crown of his skull. For the first time, Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a tone of alarm: "Not good! The consciousness of the Heavenly Eye... has actually infiltrated the Tianji Record?!"

dialogue.content: That wisp of black mist seemed alive as it spread through the Mental Sea, and a cold, vast voice exploded within Chen Ji's mind: "Miserable ant, do you think obtaining the Tianji Record allows you to reverse fate and change destiny? How laughable... From the moment you acquired the first fragment, you became merely a piece on my chessboard." The voice paused, carrying a hint of amusement: "Chen Xuan was the same, and so are you. Want to know what he said before his death? Go ask your dear Uncle—Ling Yuan, he knows far more than you do." As the words fell, the black mist abruptly withdrew, transforming into a closed eye imprint that branded itself into the deepest part of Chen Ji's Mental Sea.

text.content: Chen Ji froze completely, cold sweat soaking his back. The Heavenly Eye—the ultimate existence from legend—had actually been watching him all along? What alarmed him even more was the information revealed in those words: what did Ling Yuan know? What connection did he have to Chen Xuan's downfall? "Cough..." A mouthful of blood sprayed out, Chen Ji's face turned deathly pale, and this series of impacts nearly shattered his divine consciousness. Su Qingyao swiftly supported him, anxiously calling out: "Chen Ji! What happened to you?!" Chen Ji gripped her wrist and managed to speak: "Senior Sister Su... I need to see someone."

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye's consciousness had actually infiltrated the Tianji Record, and Ling Yuan's name was mentioned—there must be significant hidden truths here. Chen Ji faced his second choice:

choices.description: Use his newly acquired abilities as trump cards to directly confront Ling Yuan and demand the truth about what happened years ago. The risk is enormous, but it may yield crucial intelligence.
choices.visible_cost: May expose strength and bring fatal danger
choices.visible_reward: Force out Ling Yuan's hidden cards and seize the initiative
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is a hidden boss with unfathomable strength

text.content: Chen Ji slowly straightened up, a ruthless glint flickering in his eyes. Since the Heavenly Eye had proactively mentioned Ling Yuan, it meant this old fox must possess something that even it feared—and this something might be precisely the key to Chen Ji's counterstrategy. "Let's go, back to the Tianqing Sect." he said coldly, "I want to see exactly how many secrets this Uncle Ling Yuan... has been hiding."

choices.description: Risk using the causal tracing ability again to investigate the causal connection between Ling Yuan and Chen Xuan, uncovering the concealed historical truth.
choices.visible_cost: Consume another 40 Heavenly Fate points, possibly exceeding the warning threshold in total
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Ling Yuan's complete causal chain and perceive everything
choices.risk_hint: Depletion of Heavenly Fate points will trigger unknown consequences

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth, and the third page within his Mental Sea once again burst forth with dazzling golden light. "Since we're doing this, let's do it to the end!" The River of Causality surged forward, and he rapidly traced along the causal threads between Ling Yuan and Chen Xuan. The scenes along the way made him increasingly horrified—it turned out that Ling Yuan had once been Chen Xuan's most trusted junior brother. Together they discovered the Tianji Record fragments and jointly comprehended the mysteries of heavenly secrets. However, when Chen Xuan obtained the complete inheritance of the Tianji Record, Ling Yuan, consumed by jealousy, secretly colluded with the Heavenly Eye and set up a shocking lethal trap!

choices.description: Hold position, feigning ignorance, secretly observing Ling Yuan's movements, waiting for a better opportunity to strike.
choices.visible_cost: Risk missing the opportunity to take the initiative
choices.visible_reward: Avoid alerting the enemy, preserve trump cards
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may already be on guard

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the fury and impulse in his heart. "Not rush." He murmured to himself, a cold light flickering in his eyes. "Ling Yuan is crafty and deep-thinking. If I act rashly now, I'll only alert the snake. Better to... let him think everything is under his control, then find the moment to strike lethally." He turned to Su Qingyao, his face already restored to its usual timid expression. "Senior Sister Su, let's go back first. About today's matter... please keep it secret for me."

However, no matter which path was chosen, fate's script had already written its first act. While Chen Ji was secretly scheming, Ling Yuan, far away at the Tianqing Sect, suddenly clapped his hands and laughed heartily, his laughter echoing through the empty Forbidden Grounds, startling a flock of night crows. In his withered hand, he clutched a shattered communication jade slip, his murky old eyes gleaming brightly: "The Eye of Heavenly Secrets was right... this废物 boy has indeed begun tracing karma." He slowly rose, his aura as dark and unfathomable as an abyss. "Since you want to know the truth of those years, let your Shishu... personally teach you what it means to play with fire."

The words fell, Ling Yuan's figure flashed, turning into a幽暗 escape light, heading straight toward the ruins at high speed. Meanwhile, the golden bamboo slip in Chen Ji's Mental Sea suddenly trembled, an unprecedented warning surging into his heart—that was the instinct of the Tianji Record, meaning extreme danger was approaching! Mo Xiansheng's voice urgently rang out: "Bad! Ling Yuan is here... and his aura is even stronger than a few years ago! Your divine sense is damaged now, you're no match for him! Run!" Chen Ji's expression slightly changed, but he didn't panic. Instead, a meaningful smile appeared on his face: "Perfect timing... I was just worried I had no excuse to see him."

Su Qingyao sensed the unusual atmosphere, instinctively stepping in front of Chen Ji, her sword already half-unsheathed. "Chen Ji, what's going on?" She looked back at Chen Ji, her eyes full of worry. "You've been like a different person since leaving the ruins... that aura just now, and the Ling Yuan Shishu you mentioned..." Chen Ji looked at her tense expression, a warmth rising in his heart. This cold and stubborn Inner Disciple Senior Fellow was actually willing to放下身段 protect him. He gently patted her shoulder, his voice low and serious: "Senior Sister Su, what comes next may be very dangerous. Do you... trust me?"

choice.prompt: With Ling Yuan approaching, Chen Ji must make the final choice: fight head-on or have other schemes?

choices.description: Join forces with Su Qingyao to face the enemy. Even if they can't win, make Ling Yuan witness their true strength and deter him.
choices.visible_cost: May expose the existence of the Tianji Record, attracting greater covetous intentions
choices.visible_reward: Reveal true strength to Su Qingyao, increase trust
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's strength is深不可测, the risk is extremely great

text.content: Chen Ji clenched his fist, a bright light flashing in his eyes. "Since Ling Shishu wants to see how much weight I carry, then this disciple... shall respectfully comply." He stepped forward slowly, standing shoulder to shoulder with Su Qingyao, his aura suddenly changing—the mask of timidity and servility shattered completely, replaced by the posture of a hero looking down on the world! Su Qingyao's eyes widened, looking at this man beside her who seemed like a different person in disbelief. "Who... who are you?!"

choices.description: Use the ability to trace karma, predict Ling Yuan's movements, set up a trap, lure him into the scheme, and turn the tables in one decisive move.
choices.visible_cost: Requires consuming a great deal of energy to lay out
choices.visible_reward: Subdue the enemy without fighting, completely reverse the situation
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan is wily and cunning, may see through the scheme

text.content: A cold smile curled at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth. The third page in his Mental Sea quietly operated. The karma-tracing ability locked onto Ling Yuan's threads of causality, foreseeing his next three positions. "Come then..." He murmured, his hands secretly forming several talismans, spreading a天罗地网 across the void. Though Su Qingyao didn't understand, she instinctively chose to cooperate with his actions. Moments later, Ling Yuan's figure appeared at the ruins entrance. His first words made the air suddenly freeze: "Nephew Chen Ji, your Shishu has been searching hard for you... The aura of the Tianji Record is indeed hidden on you!"

choices.description: Refrain from direct confrontation with Ling Yuan, use the ruins' terrain and mechanisms to delay time, seek an opportunity to escape, and make plans later.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily show weakness, may be despised by Ling Yuan
choices.visible_reward: Preserve your strength, avoid needless losses
choices.risk_hint: May give Ling Yuan an opening

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze flickered as he quickly weighed the pros and cons in his heart. A head-on confrontation now was by no means the best strategy. Since Ling Yuan had already sensed the aura of the Tianji Record, continuing the fight would only result in mutual destruction. 'Run!' He shouted low, grabbing Su Qingyao's wrist as his figure turned into afterimages, fleeing into the depths of the ancient ruins. Behind him, Ling Yuan's laughter pursued like bone-burrowing insects: 'Trying to escape? Do you think there's anything in these ruins that can protect you? Hand over the Tianji Record willingly, and the master may spare your life...'

Ling Yuan's escape light moved like a ghost through the void, instantly closing to within ten li. Chen Ji looked back to see a gray-robed figure walking through the air, surrounded by eerie black markings. His momentum was so powerful that it seemed several times stronger than a few years ago! 'This kid...' His pupils contracted slightly as he secretly calculated, 'What fortuitous encounter did he gain in the Forbidden Grounds?' Mo Xiansheng's voice timely sounded: 'The cultivation technique Ling Yuan practices is somewhat demonic, seemingly having some kind of covenant with the Heavenly Secrets... Be careful, his current power may have reached the Half-Step Great Cultivation realm!'

'Half-Step Great Cultivation...' Chen Ji gasped. Such a realm's experts were rare as phoenix feathers in the entire Cultivation World. With his current strength, even combined with Su Qingyao, there was absolutely no chance of victory. Yet his eyes held no fear, instead flickering with a hint of playful amusement. 'So what if it's Half-Step Great Cultivation?' he murmured with a cold smile. A golden rune subtly materialized in his palm - a hidden trump card he had carefully prepared. 'Senior Uncle Ling, did you think I would appear here without any preparation?' Before his words even finished, a thunderous roar suddenly echoed from the depths of the ruins, an ancient prohibition dramatically activating and overwhelming pressure bursting forth, forcing Ling Yuan's escape light to retreat a hundred miles!

Ling Yuan's expression slightly changed, his gray robe fluttering wildly in the fierce wind. Staring at the ancient prohibition that became even more maniacal after being forced back, a trace of wariness flashed across his turbid old eyes. 'In the depths of these ruins, such a thing was actually sealed...' He didn't pursue further, instead hovering a hundred miles away, gazing distantly towards where Chen Ji disappeared. A meaningful smile curved his lips. 'Fine, I'll let you live a few more days today. However...' His voice penetrated the void, drilling directly into Chen Ji's Mental Sea. 'Next time we meet, the master won't give you a chance to escape again.' As his voice fell, his figure transformed into a gray light and vanished at the horizon.

The crisis was temporarily resolved, yet Chen Ji remained on high alert. He led Su Qingyao deep into the ruins, finding a hidden cave where he set up multiple layers of prohibitions before finally leaning against the stone wall, exhaling a long breath. 'Chen Ji...' Su Qingyao's voice trembled beside him. 'Can you tell me... who exactly are you? What's the story with that Tianji Record?' Chen Ji turned to look at her, studying those eyes filled with confusion and worry. A smile suddenly crossed his face. 'Senior Sister Su...' he softly spoke, his voice carrying a tenderness never shown before. 'There are some things I originally wanted to bury forever in my heart. But now... perhaps, it's time to tell you some truth.'

Just as Chen Ji prepared to speak, Mr. Mo's voice abruptly echoed in his Mental Sea: 'Wait!' Chen Ji was slightly stunned. His expression then changed - he sensed the newly formed third page of golden bamboo slip violently trembling, as if something was trying to break free from within! In the next instant, an old yet familiar voice pierced through time and space, directly entering his Mental Sea - it was Ling Yuan's laughter, carrying hundreds of years of suppressed resentment and madness: 'Chen Xuan, you ultimately lost! Tianji Record's inheritor? Hmph, in my eyes you're nothing but clowns jumping around!' Chen Ji's body stiffened, his pupils contracting sharply - this voice wasn't coming from the outside world, but directly from the depths of his own Mental Sea!

At the moment Chen Xuan's figure dissipated, an ancient and familiar voice pierced through time and space, directly entering Chen Ji's Mental Sea - it was Ling Yuan's laughter, carrying hundreds of years of suppressed resentment and madness: 'Chen Xuan, you ultimately lost! Tianji Record's inheritor? Hmph, in my eyes you're nothing but clowns jumping around!' Chen Ji's body stiffened, his pupils contracting sharply - this voice wasn't coming from the outside world, but directly from the depths of his own Mental Sea! Meanwhile, he saw within Chen Xuan's dissipating form a tiny, barely perceptible golden speck of light hurtling toward his Brow Center...
